Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
I thought this had been answered but I can't find it...

Minion A strikes minion B for some damage
Minion A has extra strikes
Minion A uses an extra strike to play S:CE

Can anyone play Taste of Vitae?

Presumably you can play ToV after you send someon to torpor?

If combat is ending then by definition you have reached the "end of a
round of combat" -just a premature one.
(there is an old ruling saying you can't play one after SCE because it
has to be played after strike resolution but I think that the ToV card
text has changed since then)
